ui.readout.xpWithDifficulty: Earn XP by destroying enemy ships. The larger the hull, the more XP gained. Harder battles give up to {maxBonus}% more XP, based on vanilla's battle difficulty rating. Losing combat awards {lossPercent}% of the XP.
ui.readout.body:
Allocating nodes costs ordnance points. For this hull, the cost is {opCost}

Each level this ship gains allows one free allocation. When the ship levels up, it will refund ordnance points spent on the skill tree.

You can allocate a maximum of {maxNodes} nodes.

{xpRules}

Hold Ctrl while allocating an optional node to allocate the same type again without reopening the picker.

Ctrl-Shift-click an allocated node to remove it along with every node that depends on it. Doing this on your starting point clears the tree so you can choose a new one.

Ctrl-click a Subroutine Socket to open Subroutines, allocating the socket first if it is not already allocated.
